senses.gloss:
शम्ब् शम्ब्, cl. 1. P. शम्बति, शम्बितुम्,
to go (in this sense = rt. शर्ब्), cl. 10. P.
शम्बयति, -यितुम्, to accumulate, collect, heap
together (in this sense = rts. सम्ब्, साम्ब्).

सम्ब् सम्ब् [cf. rts. सर्ब्, शम्ब्, साम्ब्], cl.
1. P. सम्बति, &c., to go, creep; cl. 10.
P. सम्बयति, -यितुम्, to collect, accumulate, con-
nect, join together.

साम्ब् साम्ब् (= rt. सम्ब्), cl. 10. P. साम्-
बयति, -यितुम्, to accumulate, collect.

शम्ब शम्ब, अस्, आ, अम् (either fr. rt. 1. शम्
or 2. शम् or rt. शम्ब्), happy, fortunate [cf. शंव
above]; poor (according to Śabda-k.); (अस्), m.
Indra's thunderbolt (Sāy. = वज्र); the iron head
of a pestle; an iron chain worn round the loins;
ploughing in the regular direction; the second plough-
ing of a field.
—शम्बा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, (a field
&c.) twice ploughed (= द्वि-हल्य, द्वि-सीत्य).

शाम्ब शाम्ब, अस्, m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa
and Jāmbavatī (frequently mentioned in the Purāṇas
and in the Mausala-parvan of the Mahā-bhārata,
where it is related that in consequence of the curse
of some holy sages who had been deceived by a
female disguise he had assumed, he was condemned
to produce offspring in the shape of a terrific iron
club for the destruction of the race of Vṛṣṇi and
Andhaka; he is said to have been instructed by
Nārada in the proper worship of the sun, and by
Vyāsa in the ritual observances of the Magi; he is
regarded as the author of the Sūrya-stotra hymn).
—शाम्ब-पुर, अम्, n. or शाम्ब-पुरी, f., N. of
a city founded by Śāmba (said to be situated on the
banks of the Candra-bhāgā).
—शाम्ब-पुराण,
अम्, n., N. of a Purāṇa.
—शाम्बादित्य (˚ब-आद्˚),
अस्, m. a particular form of the sun.
—शाम्बोप-
पुराण (˚ब-उप्˚), अम्, n., N. of an Upa-Purāṇa.

सम्ब, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. सम्ब् above),
water [cf. सम्बर]; twice ploughing, the second
ploughing of a field [cf. शम्ब].
—सम्बा-कृ, cl. 8.
P. -करोति, &c., to plough twice.
—सम्बा-कृत, अस्,
आ, अम्, twice ploughed [cf. शम्बा-कृत].

साम्ब साम्ब (स-अम्˚), अस्, m. attended by
Ambā (said of Śiva).
—सांब-शिव, अस्, m. Śiva
along with Ambā.

शम्बर शम्बर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
शम्ब् or fr. 2. शम् with rt. वृ; cf. शंवर,
सम्बर, संवर), N. of a demon of drought
[]
(represented in the Ṛg-veda as an enemy of Indra);
a cloud (= मेघ, Naigh. I. 10); a mountain (in
general) or a particular mountain; a sort of deer;
a kind of fish; war; N. of a Daitya [cf. शम्बर-
सूदन]; best, excellent; a Jina; N. of various
plants or trees (= चित्रक; = लोध्र; = अर्जुन);
(ई), f. a kind of drug or medicinal plant, Anthericum
Tuberosum (= आखु-पर्णी); a female juggler; illu-
sion; (अम्), n. water, (in Naigh. I. 12. enumerated
among the उदक-नामानि, and in Naigh. II. 9.
among the बल-नामानि); a cloud, (Sāy. शम्ब-
राणि = मेघान्, Ṛg-veda II. 24, 2); wealth; a
religious observance; a particular religious vow (with
Buddhists); = चित्रम् (according to Śabda-k.).
—शम्-
बर-कन्द, अस्, m. a kind of bulbous plant (= वा-
राही-कन्द).
—शम्बर-चन्दन, अम्, n. a
variety of sandal (= बहल-गन्ध).
—शम्बर-
सूदन, अस्, m. ‘destroyer of the Daitya Śambara,’
epithet of Kāma-deva (god of love).
—शम्बर-
हत्य, अम्, आ, n. f. the killing of Śambara.
—शम्-
बरारि (˚र-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of (the Daitya)
Śambara,’ epithet of Kāma-deva.
—शम्बरासुर
(˚र-अस्˚), अस्, m. the Asura or Daitya Śambara.
—शम्बरासुर-वधोपख्यान (˚ध-उप्˚),
अम्, n. the story of the killing of the Daitya Śambara
(told in the fifty-fifth chapter of the tenth book of
the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa).

सम्बर सम्बर, अस्, m. (apparently mixed
up and confounded with the words सं-वर, शं-
वर, शम्बर, but in some senses said to be fr. rt.
सम्ब्), a bridge, dam, causeway, (probably for सं-
वर); a kind of deer; a sort of fish; a particular
mountain; a kind of dramatic entertainment; N. of
a demon or Daitya, (see शम्बर); N. of a Jaina
Arhat of the future period; N. of a district and lake
in Rājputāna (where the salt called गड-लवण is
found; sometimes written सं-वर); (ई), f. the plant
Asparagus Racemosus (= शता-वरी); the aquatic
plant Salvinia Cucullata; (अम्), n. restraint, self-
control; a religious observance with Buddhists;
water, (in the preceding senses probably for सं-
वर, but cf. शम्बर.)
—सम्बरारि (˚र-अरि),
इस्, m. ‘enemy of Sambara,’ epithet of Kāma-deva.
—सम्बरोद्भव (˚र-उद्˚), अम्, n. ‘produced in
Sambara,’ a kind of salt (= गड-लवण).

साम्बर 1. साम्बर, अम्, n. (fr. सम्बर,
q. v.), a kind of salt (= गड-लवण).

साम्बर 2. साम्बर (स-अम्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing clothes, clothed.

शम्बल शम्बल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be
fr. rt. शम्ब्, also written शंवल, cf. सम्बल,
संवल), provender or provisions for a journey,
stock for travelling; a bank, shore; envy, jealousy,
impatience of another's success; (ई), f. a procuress,
bawd.

सम्बल, अस्, अम्, m. n. [cf. शम्बल], provender,
stock of provisions for a journey; (अम्), n. water.

शम्बु शम्बु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1.
शम्), a bivalve shell.
—शम्बु-वर्धन, अस्, m.
a proper N.

शम्बुक, अस्, m. (also written शाम्बुक, q. v.),
a bivalve shell.
शम्बुक्क, अस्, m. a bivalve shell.

शम्बूक, अस्, आ, m. f. a bivalve shell; (अस्), m.
a small conch-shell; a snail; N. of a Śūdra (who
had become a devotee and was slain by Rāma-
candra); the edge of the frontal protuberance of an
elephant; N. of a Daitya; a proper N.; = घोङ्ग
(according to Śabda-k.); [cf. Gr. σαμβύκη.]
शाम्बुक, अस्, m. a bivalve shell; [cf. शम्बुक.]
शाम्बूक, अस्, m. a bivalve shell.
शम्बू-पुत्र, अस्, m. a proper N.
शाम्बरिक शाम्बरिक, अस्, m. a proper N.

साम्बरी साम्बरी, f. (also written शाम्बरी,
q. v.), a female juggler, sorceress.

शाम्बविक शाम्बविक, अस्, m. (fr. शम्बु), a
worker or dealer in shells.
शाम्बुवि, अयस्, m. pl., N. of a Śākhā or school.

सम्बंह् सम्-बंह्, cl. 10. P. or Caus. (or Nom.
of बहुल) -बंहयति, -यितुम्, to make firm or
prosperous, establish firmly, increase.

सम्बत् सम्-बत्, ind. (according to Śabda-k.)
= सं-वत्, q. v.

सम्बन्ध् सम्-बन्ध्, cl. 9. P. -बध्नाति, &c.,
to bind together, fasten or tie together, bind or fix
on, attach, connect, to construct, form: Pass. -बध्-
यते, to be bound together, to be attached or con-
nected, belong to; to be furnished or supplied with:
Caus. -बन्धयति, -यितुम्, to cause to bind toge-
ther; to make to bind on or attach or connect.

सम्-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound or tied together,
connected; connected in sense, having meaning;
fastened together; closed, shut; bound on, fastened
or fixed on, attached; connected with, belonging to,
related, inherent, endowed with, possessing, possessed
of authority, empowered.
—सम्बद्ध-दर्प, अस्,
आ, अम्, having feelings of pride formed (in the heart).
—सम्बद्ध-सैन्यौघ (˚य-ओघ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having the main body of troops concentrated.

सम्-बध्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, binding together, at-
taching, forming (fruit as a plant &c.).

सम्-बध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being bound toge-
ther or connected.

सम्-बन्ध, अस्, m. binding together, joining
together, union, association, connection (sometimes
at the end of comps. in the sense ‘connected,’ &c.,
cf. सु-स्˚); connection by marriage [cf. स्त्री-स्˚];
relationship, relation, (in phil. said to be of
three kinds, 1. समवाय, ‘intimate relation,’ as
between a whole and its parts; 2. संयोग, ‘con-
junction,’ as between a pot and the ground; 3.
स्वरूप, ‘the nature of a thing,’ as between an
object and the knowledge of it, which last is also
called विषयता-सम्बन्ध), inherence; a rela-
tion, kinsman, relative, (कु-सम्बन्ध, अस्, m. a
wicked relation); binding, restraining, restraint; (in
grammar) the possessive case (but see कारक); the
application of authority to prove a theological doc-
trine; fitness, propriety; prosperity, success; (अस्, आ,
अम्), able, capable; fit, right, proper.
—सम्बन्ध-
तत्त्व, अम्, n. and सम्बन्ध-विवेक, अस्, m., N.
of two works.

सम्बन्धक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to, concern-
ing; fit, suitable; (अस्), m. connection by birth or
marriage; a relation, friend; (scil. सन्धि), a kind
of alliance proceeding from relationship.

सम्बन्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, connected with, belong-
ing to, relating or related to, referring to, adjunct,
inherent; possessing good qualities; (ई), m. a rela-
tion or connection (by marriage), relative, kinsman.
—सम्बन्धि-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, divided or shared
by relatives.

सम्बर्य (said to be connected with सम्बर
above), Nom. P. सम्बर्यति, -यितुम्, to bring
together [cf. rt. सम्ब्].
सम्बाकृ सम्बा-कृ. See सम्ब, col. 2.

सम्-बाध, अस्, m. pressing together, compres-
sion, contraction, pressing on, pressure, thronging,
blocking up, the being thronged; difficulty, obstruc-
tion, (sometimes at the end of comps. in the senses,
‘narrow,’ ‘contracted,’ ‘confined,’ ‘blocked up,’
‘crowded,’ ‘completely covered or strewn,’ ‘ob-
structed;’ cf. हस्त्य्-अश्व-रथ-स्˚, शर-स्˚); the
female organ of generation; the road to Naraka or
hell; fear, dread.

सम्-बाधक, अस्, आ, अम्, pressing together, com-
pressing, contracting; pressing upon, thronging,
crowding.

सम्-बाधन, अम्, n. the act of pressing to-
gether or compressing; thronging, obstructing, op-
posing; a barrier, gate; the female organ, (according
to Śabda-k. = मदनस्य द्वार); a door-keeper;
the point of a stake or spit.

सम्बुध् सम्-बुध्, cl. 1. P. A., 4. A. -बोधति,
-ते, -बुध्यते (ep. also P. -ति), &c., to perceive or
understand thoroughly, have perfect knowledge of;
to perceive, notice, observe, know; to wake up:
Caus. -बोधयति, -यितुम्, to cause to know, inform,
instruct, advise; exhort, admonish; to explain; to
make attentive, cause to wake up, rouse; to call to;
to cause to agree.

सम्-बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, well perceived, perfectly
known or understood; thoroughly awake; exces-
sively wise, prudent, clever; (अस्), m. a Buddha or
Jaina deified sage.

सम्-बुद्धि, इस्, f. perfect knowledge or per-
ception; calling to; the vocative case (= सम्-
बोधन); an epithet.
सम्-बुध्य, ind. awaking, waking up.
सम्-बुध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being quite aware.

सम्-बोध, अस्, m. explaining, instructing, in-
forming; throwing, sending; loss, destruction.

सम्-बोधन, अम्, n. the act of causing to know
thoroughly, informing, instructing, explanation, call-
ing to, addressing; the vocative case (in gram.).

सम्-बोधयित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having caused
to be informed, having instructed.
सम्-बोधित, अस्, आ, अम्, fully warned, duly apprised.

सम्-बोधितवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has duly
warned or apprised.

सम्-बोध्य, ind. having explained, having made
an excuse or apology.

सम्बृह् सम्-बृह् or सम्-बृंह्. See सं-
वृंह्, p. 1038.

सम्ब्रू सम्-ब्रू, cl. 2. P. A. -ब्रवीति, -ब्रूते,
&c. (see rt. ब्रू, p. 694), to speak with, converse
with; to talk together, agree; to say anything to
any one (with two acc.).

साम्बन्धिक साम्बन्धिक, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. सम्-
बन्ध), belonging to or proceeding from relation-
ship; (अम्), n. (probably) alliance.
साम्बवती साम्बवती, f., N. of a woman.

साम्बेश्वर (˚ब-ईश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a particular
idol or of a temple built by Sāmbavatī.
